newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk security forces kill 42 rebels, agency says.
newsitem.headline: Turk security forces kill 42 rebels, agency says.

text.p: Turkish security forces have killed 42 Kurdish guerrillas in the past three days in southeastern Turkey, Anatolian news agency reported on Sunday.
It said a government-paid village guard was also killed in the operation, backed by Turkey's airforce, against the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels in Sirnak province near the Iraqi border.
More than 21,000 people have died in the PKK's 12-year-old armed struggle with the military for an independent state or autonomy.
